message: Help me create a new collection. First read `config/helps/collection-skills.md` for the schema-driven collection conventions. Then use the `presentForm` tool (do not use AskUserQuestion) to ask me what kind of data I want to track, and author the schema.json and SKILL.md from my answers.
I'll start by reading the collection conventions doc.
I've read the collection conventions. Now let me ask you what you'd like to track.
The MCP server just connected. Let me load the `presentForm` tool schema.

args.title: New Collection Setup
args.description: Tell me what you'd like to track and I'll build a schema-driven collection for it. Only the first question is required — leave the rest blank to accept my sensible defaults.

fields.label: What do you want to track?
fields.description: Describe the collection in plain language — e.g. 'books I've read', 'job applications', 'plants and their watering schedule', 'home gym workouts'. The more detail, the better the schema.
fields.placeholder: e.g. Job applications: company, role, status (applied / interviewing / offer / rejected), date applied, salary, notes

fields.label: Which fields / columns matter? (optional)
fields.description: List the pieces of info for each record. Note anything special: a status with fixed choices, a due date, money amounts, a rating, a photo, a link. Leave blank and I'll infer them.
fields.placeholder: e.g. company (text), role (text), status (applied/interviewing/offer/rejected), applied date, salary (money), link to posting, notes

fields.label: Any of these workflow features? (optional)
fields.description: Pick any that apply — I'll wire them into the schema. All optional.
choices: Kanban board (drag records between status columns)
Calendar view (records shown on a date grid)
Reminders / bell notifications when something is due or incomplete
Recurring records (auto-create the next one, e.g. rent, subscriptions)

fields.label: Short name for the URL (optional)
fields.description: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (e.g. 'job-apps', 'reading-list'). It becomes /collections/<name>. Leave blank and I'll pick one.
